mockup_v1.png.avoid: Avoid shield-and-padlock illustrations, security-score dashboards, and alarming red warnings.
mockup_v1.png.mood: Printed page: warm, discreet and assured, like a carefully typeset privacy notice. Keep the complete 380×600 popup light, with no browser chrome.
mockup_v1.png.name: 1 — Private Edition
mockup_v1.png.palette: Use background #F7F4EC, surface #FFFCF5, primary text #242820, secondary text #596052 and accent #356B32. The brief’s green overrides the suggested accent hues in every direction. Reserve green for the primary master switch, selected controls, the protected-site dot and the key value ‘7’; keep its total coverage below 10%. Secondary text exceeds 4.5:1 on both backgrounds.
mockup_v1.png.shape: Use radii 0, 4 and 8px: square section boundaries, 4px toggle chips and segmented-control segments, 8px site chip and master-switch housing. Use a rectangular sliding master switch with a clear inset thumb. Separate sections with fine neutral rules; use no floating cards or shadows. Use restrained monochrome line icons.
mockup_v1.png.signature: Place one narrow, softly blurred ink stripe behind the small Veil logo mark, suggesting concealed writing. Keep the wordmark and all functional text crisp.
mockup_v1.png.spacing: Use 20px side margins, 8px gaps within groups, 16px between groups and 12px padding inside the master-control surface. Arrange header, master control, site chip, Blur, Smart guards, chat override and footer vertically. Use a 3-column × 2-row Blur grid with 32px-high chips and 8px gaps; use 56px guard rows. Keep status text on one line with a condensed face, 12px icons and compact switches.
mockup_v1.png.type: Use a warm editorial serif for the Veil wordmark and the 24px hero ‘Protection on’; use a narrow humanist sans for controls and statuses. Use an 11/12/14/18/24px scale. Show ‘WhatsApp Web · protected’ with a green dot. Label ‘Blur’ above six toggle chips: Chat list, Names, Photos, Messages, Media, Typing. Label ‘Smart guards’ above three icon/title/status/switch rows: ‘Sensitive content’ / ‘7 items hidden on this page’; ‘Shoulder-surfer guard’ / ‘Camera off · blurs when a 2nd face appears’; ‘Auto-blur when away’ / ‘After 30s idle or when you switch tabs’. Follow with ‘This chat — Rahim Ahmed’ and Default / Always blur / Never blur. Set ‘Panic: Alt+Shift+V’ left and a gear ‘Settings’ link right in the footer.

mockup_v2.png.avoid: Avoid incognito-spy imagery, neon hacker terminals, and oversized reassuring checkmarks.
mockup_v2.png.mood: Quiet greyscale: precise, calm and premium, with typography and alignment carrying the interface. Keep the complete 380×600 popup light, with no browser chrome.
mockup_v2.png.name: 2 — Discreet Instrument
mockup_v2.png.palette: Use background #FAFAF8, surface #EFEFED, primary text #202522, secondary text #5B625D and accent #286849. Follow the brief’s green requirement instead of the suggested sky blue. Keep almost everything neutral; use green only for the primary master switch, selected controls, protected-site dot and the key value ‘7’, covering less than 10%. Secondary text exceeds 4.5:1 on both backgrounds.
mockup_v2.png.shape: Use radii 0, 4 and 12px: square divider-led sections, 4px Blur chips and segmented control, 12px site chip and switch tracks. Use flat surfaces and precise 1px neutral borders; omit shadows. Align compact outline icons, row titles and switch edges into consistent vertical columns.
mockup_v2.png.signature: Make the small Veil mark from three parallel vertical strokes, with only the middle stroke softly blurred. Repeat that exact mark nowhere else; let it identify the otherwise restrained utility.
mockup_v2.png.spacing: Use 16px side margins, 4px gaps within text groups, 16px between sections and 12px surface padding. Put the small logo and wordmark at top, then a full-width master row and site chip. Use 8px gaps in the 3×2 Blur grid, 32px chip heights and 56px Smart guards rows. Reserve a 12px icon column and 28px switch column so every status remains one line. Anchor the two footer items to opposite edges.
mockup_v2.png.type: Use a compact neo-grotesque with open counters and tabular numerals; use a condensed companion for 11px statuses. Set the hero ‘Protection on’ at 24px semibold and use an 11/12/14/18/24px scale. Include ‘WhatsApp Web · protected’ with a green dot. Under ‘Blur’, show Chat list, Names, Photos, Messages, Media, Typing as six toggle chips. Under ‘Smart guards’, give each row an icon and switch: ‘Sensitive content’ / ‘7 items hidden on this page’; ‘Shoulder-surfer guard’ / ‘Camera off · blurs when a 2nd face appears’; ‘Auto-blur when away’ / ‘After 30s idle or when you switch tabs’. Add ‘This chat — Rahim Ahmed’ above Default / Always blur / Never blur. Finish with ‘Panic: Alt+Shift+V’ left and gear ‘Settings’ right.

mockup_v3.png.avoid: Avoid antivirus-style scan meters, grids of colourful feature tiles, and decorative frosted-glass panels.
mockup_v3.png.mood: Clean canvas: approachable, composed and quietly capable. Make this feel like a polished everyday browser utility. Keep the complete 380×600 popup light, with no browser chrome.
mockup_v3.png.name: 3 — Clear Boundary
mockup_v3.png.palette: Use background #F4F5F0, surface #FFFFFF, primary text #192D25, secondary text #526159 and one emerald accent #08734F. Use emerald only for the primary master switch, selected controls, protected-site dot and the key value ‘7’; keep coverage below 10%. Secondary text exceeds 4.5:1 on both backgrounds. Use neutral borders and neutral secondary switch states.
mockup_v3.png.shape: Use radii 4, 8 and 16px: 4px segmented-control segments, 8px Blur chips and site chip, 16px master-control surface and switch tracks. Give only the master-control surface a faint downward shadow. Keep the remaining sections directly on the canvas, separated by space and hairlines. Use simple, consistent outline icons.
mockup_v3.png.signature: Give the master-control surface a single vertical boundary: a crisp 1px rule with a soft neutral blur immediately to its left. Confine the effect to that edge so the protection control remains clear and readable.
mockup_v3.png.spacing: Use 16px side margins, 8px gaps within groups, 16px between groups and 16px master-surface padding. Stack the small Veil logo and wordmark, prominent master control, site chip, Blur grid, Smart guards, chat override and footer. Set Blur chips in a 3×2 grid with 8px gaps and 32px heights. Use 56px guard rows with 12px icons and compact switches; preserve one-line statuses. Keep the footer on one horizontal baseline.
mockup_v3.png.type: Use a humanist sans with slightly squared curves; pair it with a narrow companion for statuses. Make ‘Protection on’ the 24px semibold hero beside the large master switch. Use an 11/12/14/18/24px scale. Show ‘WhatsApp Web · protected’ with a green dot. Include ‘Blur’ with Chat list, Names, Photos, Messages, Media, Typing. Include ‘Smart guards’ with three icon/title/status/switch rows: ‘Sensitive content’ / ‘7 items hidden on this page’; ‘Shoulder-surfer guard’ / ‘Camera off · blurs when a 2nd face appears’; ‘Auto-blur when away’ / ‘After 30s idle or when you switch tabs’. Set ‘This chat — Rahim Ahmed’ above Default / Always blur / Never blur. Place ‘Panic: Alt+Shift+V’ at footer left and gear ‘Settings’ at right.
